name: Neon Moon Bar & Lounge
description: Neon Moon is a vibrant karaoke bar known for its lively atmosphere, diverse crowd, and extensive song selection. The venue offers a great sound system, friendly staff, and a welcoming environment that encourages guests to be themselves. With live music, themed nights, and a spacious patio, Neon Moon stands out as a top spot for fun, singing, and socializing in Lexington. Food and drinks are available, making it an ideal place for a night out with friends or celebrating special occasions.
